productPageReviews.reviewTitle: I recommend for anyone who loves frogs
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Nice pages , backed with black so that they will not bleed , fun designs - enjoyed coloring with my family to honor a family members love for frogs while they where sick in the hospital. It is was a nice creative and therapeutic time to unplug , connect with your inner creative, and enjoy this activity during a hard time.

raw_products.bookDescription: From the bestselling author of The Little Frog's Guide to Self-Care. Unlock your creativity with this uplifting coloring book featuring the Little Frog Whether you turn to the Little Frog for comforting words, a dose of inspiration or a reminder of the everyday magic all around us, this soothing coloring book is the perfect way to enjoy the wisdom from your favorite amphibian while embracing your creative side! Created by the Minnesota-based artist Maybell Eequay, this coloring book is a perfect compassionate gift for yourself or others. Inside you will find: - A collection of your favorite Little Frog scenes ready for you to bring to life with color - Gentle pearls of wisdom and inspiration for hard days - Encouraging affirmations to remind you of your inner strength and goodness Brimming with gentle humour and loving kindness, this beautiful coloring book is here to fill your heart with love, color and joy. So, pick up your pencils and begin your creative journey into the wonderful world of the Little Frog!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: For fans of the little frog!For fans of the little frog!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Huge fan of the little frog so I love all the designs in this book, including the inspirational quotes. It's double sided so you can't use alcohol markers. The paper is pretty good. I used water based markers and it didn't bleed through. Overall very happy with my purchase, although I always prefer single sided books so I can use alcohol markers. ☺️
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2026Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Cute! But can’t tear out any of the pages :(
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve been waiting to this to arrive after preordering it and was so excited to finally have it! Cute, meaningful, and a nice dopamine boost! My only complaint is not being able to tear the pages out. I actually bought this and some fancy markers for my clients who like to doodle or color in sessions, so it’s more so become my own coloring book. I have some of The Little Frog products in my office, which are a big hit with my ladies, so was excited to have these to share with them.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 13, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The illustrations are hand drawn, unique and cute. The paper is good quality and not Amazon printed. The sayings included on each page are gentle, reflective, and thoughtful. Each page brings a smile to my face! I adore seeing this frog wearing fancy boots and shoes! This book is a gem and I am glad I found it. Only wish the pages were singled sided so that alcohol markers could be used to color with in the book. But that is a minor issue. The paper quality will allow the use of other mediums and still provide an enjoyable coloring experience in this beautiful book! Happy Coloring!
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 27, 2026
